newsitem.title: USA: U.S. releases $20 Mln grant for Everglades land.
newsitem.headline: U.S. releases $20 Mln grant for Everglades land.

text.p: The Clinton administration will release an additional $20 million grant for land acquisition for the Florida Everglades, Vice President Al Gore announced Wednesday.

The grant would double the amount of federal funds provided to the South Florida Water Management District for land purchases in the East Coast Water Preserve Area and the Everglades Agricultural Area, the White House said.
Gore announced the grant in a telephone call to Florida Governor Lawton Chiles and water district officials.
"Restoration of the Everglades is one of President Clinton's top environmental priorities, as well as an economic imperative for South Florida," he said in a statement.
With matching funds from the water district, $80 million was available, allowing purchase of about 10,000 acres.
The budget agreement reached this month between the White House and Congress allows $300 million for Everglades restoration in fiscal 1998.
